name: Synthesize UI from Data
description: Converts any impulse shape into a ui_component primitive using shape-mapping configuration. Handles column type inference, layout composition, and LLM fallback for unknown shapes.

tasks.description: Look up the input shape in shape-mapping.json and determine the target primitive type

config.command: cat config/shape-mapping.json | bun -e "const m=JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text()); const shape='{{inputShape}}'; console.log(JSON.stringify(m[shape] || {type:'code',defaults:{language:'json'}}));"

tasks.description: Transform the raw input data into the primitive spec format. Infer column types for tabular data (ISO dates → date, numeric strings → number). Compose nested primitives for container mappings.
Emit the synthesized primitive spec as a ui_component impulse via render_ui tool

variables.name: primitive_spec
variables.description: The synthesized primitive JSON to render
